rows.note: Use 成效 as the all-purpose noun for how well something produces results or succeeds.

example.english: The effectiveness of this method is pretty good.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 ge3 sing4 haau6 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use 效力 when stressing potency or efficacy, especially that of a drug, treatment, or measure.

example.english: This medicine's effectiveness is quite impressive.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 haau6 lik6 gei2 koeng4

rows.note: Use 效能 for the technical capacity or performance of a machine, system, or method to achieve its intended results.

example.english: This computer's effectiveness is very high.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 haau6 nang4 hou2 gou1
